displayName: OCI-AI-PD-002: AI — Multi-Turn Prompt Injection Chain
description:
Detects multi-turn prompt injection where the attack is distributed across multiple interactions

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%multi%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%turn%') AND "value" > 0
